mapper.sql: COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ts.education_level SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_csys_course c2 INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tcs ON tcs.course_id = c2.id INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme ts ON ts.id = tcs.scheme_id AND ts.sysflag = 0 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND ts.education_level IS NOT NULL AND ts.education_level != ''), course.education_level) AS education_level, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sm.name SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_csys_course c2 INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tcs ON tcs.course_id = c2.id INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme ts ON ts.id = tcs.scheme_id AND ts.sysflag = 0 LEFT JOIN t_csys_std_major sm ON sm.id = ts.major_id WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND ts.major_id IS NOT NULL), (SELECT sm.name FROM t_csys_std_major sm WHERE sm.id = course.major_Id)) AS major_name, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c2.course_attr SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_csys_course c2 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND c2.course_attr IS NOT NULL AND c2.course_attr != ''), course.course_attr) AS course_attr, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c2.course_Module SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_csys_course c2 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND c2.course_Module IS NOT NULL AND c2.course_Module != ''), course.course_Module) AS course_module

COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c2.open_term SEPARATOR '、') FROM t_csys_course c2 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND c2.open_term IS NOT NULL AND c2.open_term != ''), course.open_term) AS term
mapper.select:
SELECT course.id AS course_id, course.name AS course_name, course.code AS course_code, course.teach_college_id AS teach_college_id, , course.course_Module_Children AS course_module_children, course.type AS course_type, course.version AS version, course.program_Level AS program_level, course.sub_Major_Id AS sub_major_id, course.major_Id AS major_id, course.hours AS hours, course.credit AS credit, plan.id AS teaching_plan_id, plan.plan_type AS plan_type, plan.version AS plan_version, plan.current_flag AS current_flag, plan.enabled_term AS enabled_term, plan.status AS status, plan.file_id AS file_id, plan.file_name AS file_name, plan.source_credit AS source_credit FROM t_csys_course course LEFT JOIN t_csys_teaching_plan plan ON course.id = plan.source_course_id AND plan.sysflag = 0 AND plan.current_flag = 1
course.source_id IS NULL AND course.sysflag = 0
AND course.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')
AND course.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseCode}, '%')
AND course.teach_college_id = #{teachCollegeId}
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_csys_course c2 INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tcs ON tcs.course_id = c2.id INNER JOIN t_csys_training_scheme ts ON ts.id = tcs.scheme_id AND ts.sysflag = 0 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND ts.education_level = #{educationLevel}) OR course.education_level = #{educationLevel})
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_csys_course c2 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND c2.course_Module = #{courseModule}) OR course.course_Module = #{courseModule})
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_csys_course c2 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0 AND c2.course_attr = #{courseAttr}) OR course.course_attr = #{courseAttr})
AND course.type = #{type}
AND course.version = #{version}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_csys_course c2 WHERE c2.source_id = course.id AND c2.sysflag = 0)
ORDER BY course.id DESC

SELECT course.id AS course_id, NULL AS teaching_plan_id, course.name AS course_name, course.code AS course_code, course.en_name AS course_en_name, course.type AS course_type, NULL AS enabled_term, , , course.major_Id AS major_id, course.teach_hours AS teach_hours, course.practice_hours AS practice_hours, course.hours AS hours, course.credit AS credit FROM t_csys_course course WHERE course.id = #{courseId} AND course.sysflag = 0

SELECT plan.source_course_id AS course_id, plan.id AS teaching_plan_id, plan.source_course_name AS course_name, plan.source_course_code AS course_code, plan.source_course_en_name AS course_en_name, course.type AS course_type, plan.enabled_term AS enabled_term, , , course.major_Id AS major_id, COALESCE(plan.source_teach_hours, course.teach_hours) AS teach_hours, COALESCE(plan.source_practice_hours, course.practice_hours) AS practice_hours, COALESCE(plan.source_hours, course.hours) AS hours, COALESCE(plan.source_credit, course.credit) AS credit FROM t_csys_teaching_plan plan INNER JOIN t_csys_course course ON course.id = plan.source_course_id AND course.sysflag = 0 WHERE plan.id = #{teachingPlanId} AND plan.sysflag = 0
